title: "IMD and antibiotics"
format: html
---

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Antimicrobial exposure overlay on fungal and viral PCoA plots
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(vegan)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# File paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

project_root <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project"

data_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Figures")
results_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Results")

metadata_file_tsv <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

viral_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_viral_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

out_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "antimicrobial_pcoa_overlay")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

meta <- read.delim(
  metadata_file_tsv,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Function to generate antimicrobial PCoA overlay
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_antimicrobial_pcoa <- function(matrix_file, dataset_label, output_prefix) {
  
  mat <- read.delim(
    matrix_file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  matrix_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(mat))
  
  unmatched <- setdiff(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)
  
  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    stop("Unmatched samples found in ", dataset_label)
  }
  
  meta_matched <- meta[
    match(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID),
  ]
  
  if (!all(meta_matched$reads_ID == matrix_ids_clean)) {
    stop("Metadata order mismatch in ", dataset_label)
  }
  
  rownames(mat) <- matrix_ids_clean
  rownames(meta_matched) <- matrix_ids_clean
  
  mat <- mat[, colSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  mat <- mat[rowSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  meta_matched <- meta_matched[rownames(mat), , drop = FALSE]
  
  rel_abund <- vegan::decostand(mat, method = "total")
  bray <- vegan::vegdist(rel_abund, method = "bray")
  
  pcoa <- cmdscale(bray, eig = TRUE, k = 2)
  
  positive_eigs <- pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]
  axis1_pct <- round(100 * positive_eigs[1] / sum(positive_eigs), 2)
  axis2_pct <- round(100 * positive_eigs[2] / sum(positive_eigs), 2)
  
  pcoa_df <- data.frame(
    reads_ID = rownames(rel_abund),
    sample_label = meta_matched$sample_label,
    Axis1 = pcoa$points[, 1],
    Axis2 = pcoa$points[, 2],
    outcome = meta_matched$outcome,
    sPTB34 = meta_matched$sPTB34,
    antimicrobial_status = meta_matched$currentlyonantibiotics_antiretroviral,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  pcoa_df$antimicrobial_status <- ifelse(
    is.na(pcoa_df$antimicrobial_status),
    "No recorded exposure",
    pcoa_df$antimicrobial_status
  )
  
  pcoa_df$antimicrobial_status <- factor(
    pcoa_df$antimicrobial_status,
    levels = c("No recorded exposure", "antibiotics", "antiviral")
  )
  
  write.csv(
    pcoa_df,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_pcoa_antimicrobial_coordinates.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(
    pcoa_df,
    aes(
      x = Axis1,
      y = Axis2,
      colour = antimicrobial_status
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        "No recorded exposure" = "grey70",
        "antibiotics" = "#d73027",
        "antiviral" = "#4575b4"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "No recorded exposure",
        "Antibiotics",
        "Antivirals"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(dataset_label, " PCoA coloured by antimicrobial exposure"),
      x = paste0("PCoA1 (", axis1_pct, "%)"),
      y = paste0("PCoA2 (", axis2_pct, "%)"),
      colour = "Antimicrobial exposure"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black")
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_pcoa_antimicrobial_overlay.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 7.4,
    height = 5.4,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  return(pcoa_df)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run fungal and viral antimicrobial overlays
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fungal_pcoa_antimicrobial <- make_antimicrobial_pcoa(
  matrix_file = fungal_file,
  dataset_label = "RefSeq fungal genus",
  output_prefix = "refseq_fungal"
)

viral_pcoa_antimicrobial <- make_antimicrobial_pcoa(
  matrix_file = viral_file,
  dataset_label = "RefSeq viral genus",
  output_prefix = "refseq_viral"
)

cat("\nAntimicrobial PCoA overlay plots complete.\n")
cat("Figures saved to:\n", out_dir, "\n")
```
